bills.summary: Promotes low-carbon mobility and carbon capture and storage, and creates a sustainable fuels programme.
Creates a national strategy to encourage domestic production of essential health-system supplies.
Exempts public education workers from the pay and career freezes of the Covid-era LC 173/2020.
Creates a registry of people convicted of pedophilia crimes.
Creates the Energy Transition Acceleration Programme (Paten) with financing incentives.
Lets fire-department pre-hospital rescue services receive health-budget funds.
Widens parliamentary immunity and prerogatives (the 'PEC da Blindagem').
Creates a special regime to update and regularise undeclared assets (Rearp).
Creates special retirement and social protection for community health and anti-epidemic agents.
Stops Brazilians losing nationality merely for acquiring another one.
Approves a Brazil–India investment cooperation and facilitation agreement.
Makes Black Consciousness Day a national holiday.
Sets a legal framework for culture funding by public administrations.
Changes the Traffic Code on use of fine revenue and driver licensing for low-income people.
Creates a legal framework for credit guarantees and related financial-market rules.
Sets a new deadline for projects to get SUDENE/SUDAM regional income-tax incentives.
Creates the National Education System (SNE).
Creates dedicated accounts for health transfers to private providers and university hospitals.
Changes the effects of sanctions under the administrative improbity law.
Removes forestry (silviculture) from the list of potentially polluting activities.
Approves an agreement on linked border localities.
Extends to corn bran and oil the PIS/Cofins tax treatment given to soy.
Lets municipalities join municipal price-registry minutes in public procurement.
Creates commissioned functions and permanent posts at the National Council of Justice.
Sets a minimum share of the prison fund for training prison staff and police officers.
Creates an emergency debt-renegotiation programme for individuals and a cap on revolving credit-card interest.
Gives municipalities time to move to lower FPM participation coefficients.
Ends resolutive clauses in land titles issued before 1997.
Changes the PERSE events-sector programme and sets some PIS/Cofins rates to zero.
Guarantees information about reconstructive breast surgery after cancer treatment.
Sets deadlines and conditions for the Environmental Regularization Programme under the Forest Code.
Changes public-forest management and the Chico Mendes biodiversity institute.
Sets transfer-pricing rules for corporate income tax.
Extends periodic toxicology tests for drivers and changes cargo-insurance rules.
Subjects reversal of final tax rulings contrary to constitutional-court decisions to a rescission action.
Gives priority processing to crimes of slave-like labor.
Bars benefits for people who occupy or invade rural properties.
Institutes the Bolsa Família programme.
